annotations.title: Robinhood Chain swaps for a token

description: The latest stored swaps of one Robinhood Chain token, newest first (limit 1-200, side 'buy' or 'sell' to filter): time, side, wallet prefix, ETH sent on a buy, token amount, venue and transaction hash. A sell's ETH is left empty because the router's minimum is not what the seller received.
